examples.english: We will deliver the latest information.

notes:
{最新|さいしん} means "latest" or "newest" and functions as both a noun and a の-adjective.

COMPONENTS:
- {最|さい}: most, -est (superlative)
- {新|しん}: new

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {最新|さいしん}⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧: latest information/news
- {最新|さいしん}⟦{版|ばん}→版：03698_han⟧: latest version/edition
- {最新|さいしん}⟦{型|がた}→型：02146_kata⟧: latest model
- {最新|さいしん}⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧: latest technology
- {最新|さいしん}⟦{作|さく}→作：27430_saku⟧: latest work (film, book, etc.)

CONTRAST:
- {最新|さいしん}: latest (most recent)
- ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧: new (general)
- ⟦{新品|しんぴん}→新品：08303_shinpin⟧: brand new (unused item)

USAGE:
Very common in news, technology, fashion, and product descriptions. Often used adjectivally: {最新|さいしん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{ニュース|にゅーす}→ニュース：04437_nyuusu⟧ (the latest news).
